items.source:
Return an adapted version of the source changed through the given adapter
function.
items.translation: 返回通过给定适配器函数修改后的源版本的适配版本。

items.source:
Complete the mapping by calling the specified method when the value has not
been filtered.
items.translation: 通过在被过滤的值未进行过滤时调用指定的方法来完成映射。

items.source:
Complete the mapping by creating a new instance from the non-filtered
value.
items.translation: 通过从未过滤的值创建新实例来完成映射。

items.source: Complete the mapping for any non-filtered value by applying the given function to an existing instance and returning a new one. For filtered values, the instance parameter is returned unchanged. The method is designed to be used with immutable objects.
items.translation: 为任何非过滤值完成映射，通过应用给定函数到现有实例并返回一个新实例。对于过滤值，`instance` 参数将原样返回。该方法旨在用于不可变对象。

items.source:
Complete the mapping by passing any non-filtered value to the specified
consumer. The method is designed to be used with mutable objects.
items.translation: 通过向指定的消费者传递任何非过滤值来完成映射。此方法旨在与可变对象一起使用。
